messages:
anya: Hi team — married overseas, trying to add spouse. Municipality sent a digital certificate; apostille backlog. Can we get retro coverage?

maya-hr: Congrats! :tada: Short answer: maybe. We accept consular/embassy certification or the foreign doc + certified English translation. If apostille delayed, consular evidence helps.

anya: I missed the 30-day QLE window because of processing delays. Any flexibility?

maya-hr: We normally allow 30 days. For documented international delays we can extend to 60 days for submission; retro coverage up to 90 days is possible with manager + HR approval and good evidence (consular stamp, appointment receipts).

anya: How do I submit? Portal vs email?

maya-hr: Use Benefits Portal -> My Open Requests -> Add Dependent -> Upload Documents. Email benefits@redwood.ai only if portal unavailable.

anya: Payroll implications?

sam-payroll: If coverage is set retro to marriage date, payroll will do a retro adjustment on the next pay run after HR finalizes the change (usually 1-2 pay cycles).

anya: Uploaded consular-stamped PDF + certified translation. What next?

hr-bot: Ticket #PO-2024-2014 created and assigned to maya-hr.

maya-hr: Got it, thanks. Will review and loop in manager for signoff. Expect confirmation within 3 business days.

anya: Thanks everyone! :pray:
